defects: Conclusion is stated with `Module.rank` (Cardinal-valued dimension) instead of `Module.finrank`/`finrank` (ℕ-valued dimension) as in the gold theorem `IsFractionRing.finrank_right_eq`; rank equality is strictly stronger than and not equivalent to finrank equality in general (finrank truncates infinite cardinals to 0, so finrank-equal modules need not be rank-equal), so this changes the proposition being stated.

Uses the concrete canonical type `FractionRing R` for S instead of an abstract type S with `[IsFractionRing R S]` as in the gold statement; while essentially canonical (any such S is uniquely isomorphic to FractionRing R), it narrows the statement from 'for all fraction fields S of R' to 'for the specific construction FractionRing R'.
